data.1: Performance Highlights: • 69% reduction in profit after tax mainly on account of two key non-cash movements. (i) Lower revaluation gains recorded on investment property held by Centum Real Estate & Two Rivers Land Co. (ii) increase in tax driven by deferred tax on asset reclassifications and change in the deferred tax rate for investment property not for sale from 5% to 15%. ▪ Performance improvement was recorded across all other segments. ▪ Improvement in other comprehensive income and total comprehensive income on account of better performance and valuation of unquoted investments in the year. 28
